episodes.title: Hellsing I
episodes.summary: During a mission to eradicate a vampire priest and his minions, Arucard is forced into a difficult decision upon encountering an injured police woman. Later, Father Alexander Anderson and Arucard clash for the first time..

episodes.title: Hellsing II
episodes.summary: Two daring vampire brothers lead a violent raid on the Hellsing compound. The carnage is great, but Arucard and company manage to gain a key piece of information while turning the battle's tide.

episodes.title: Hellsing III
episodes.summary: The Hellsing organization resorts to the recruitment of mercenaries in the wake of a devastating attack on headquarters, and Integra's suspicions concerning the origins of their enemy are confirmed.

episodes.title: Hellsing IV
episodes.summary: An important meeting between Hellsing and the Queen is interrupted by tidings of impending war. Meanwhile, Arucard is sent to deal with the deviants responsible for the hijacking of an aircraft carrier.<

episodes.title: Hellsing V
episodes.summary: While Arucard is trapped aboard an aircraft carrier, London is plagued by a gruesome vampire onslaught. Elsewhere, Integra narrowly escapes a hoard of Nazi vampires

episodes.title: Hellsing VI
episodes.summary: The Vatican's formidable combat unit is mobilized in preparation for battle. Back in the heart of London, the Hellsing Mansion is attacked, and the Wild Geese represent the last line of defense against the undead.

episodes.title: Hellsing VII
episodes.summary: When her memories are violated, Seras becomes trapped in an illusion which forces her to relive the most horrifying moments of her life. Upon waking from the nightmare, the real pain begins as the battle nears its end.

episodes.title: Hellsing VIII
episodes.summary: This harrowing episode features the epic return of Arucard - and Integra's willingness to unleash his true power on their enemies!

episodes.title: Hellsing IX
episodes.summary: Arucard, gravely injured, recalls his painful childhood, his supernatural transformation, and violent and bloody altercation with Walter.

episodes.title: Hellsing X
episodes.summary: Shocking revelations and epic bloodlettings highlight this harrowing final chapter in the Hellsing Ultimate Saga. Find out what becomes of Arucard and the rest of the supernatural freak show!
